about.aiDisclosure: Ashen Spire was created with generative AI. Its code, art, music, sound, text and design were produced with AI tools under human direction. It contains no licensed third-party assets; the provenance of every generated asset is recorded.
about.lead.1: Ashen Spire was built by AI under human direction. The game’s code, design, writing, and art pipelines were authored by AI assistants (Anthropic’s Claude) working under the human developer’s instruction, review, and testing.
about.lead.2: Most shipped art is generated by that code — the game’s own placeholder renderer and AI-written 3D rendering pipelines. The four playable class figures are the exception, and were made by a different system: they were produced with an AI image-generation model (OpenAI’s ChatGPT Codex) and prepared for the game by AI-written tooling.
about.lead.3: The sound effects are synthesized by AI-written code at runtime, and the soundtrack was composed as code by AI: written note by note and rendered by an AI-written synthesizer, with no samples and no AI music model. Hosted builds play the rendered tracks; the game's own synthesized score stands in wherever they cannot load. No AI runs while you play: nothing in the game is AI-generated at runtime, and the game contacts no AI service.

about.section.art.body: Nearly every visual is generated by code. Sprites, icons and panels are drawn at runtime by the game itself; the enemy figures, act backdrops and equipment art are pre-rendered by procedural Blender scripts that the AI wrote. The four playable class figures are the one exception: they were produced with an AI image-generation model (ChatGPT Codex), then cut out and framed for the game by AI-written tooling. Every such file is listed in CREDITS with its source and licence.
about.section.art.heading: Art
about.section.audio.body: Every sound effect is synthesized as you play by AI-written code. The music was composed as code by AI: each track is written as notes in music/score/ and rendered offline by an AI-written synthesizer, with no samples and no AI music model. A build served from the web plays those renders; a build opened from a file on disk, or any screen whose track cannot load, uses the game's live synthesized score instead.
about.section.audio.heading: Audio
about.section.code.body: The engine, interface, tools, and the design specification were written by AI assistants working as a team of specialist personas, under the direction of the human developer — who set the goals, reviewed the work, played the builds, and holds final approval on everything that ships.
about.section.code.heading: Code and design
about.section.play.body: No AI model runs in this game, on your machine or anywhere else. Nothing is generated while you play, and the game never contacts an AI service. The only network features are optional local co-op and loading music files: the rendered score beside the game, or an optional folder of your own.
about.section.play.heading: While you play
about.section.saves.body: Your profile and runs are yours. When something cannot be read, it is set aside rather than deleted, and Profile on the title screen lists the copies still in the drawer — with a button to save any of them to a file. Profile copies are never deleted to make room. Run copies are kept for up to six months, with the newest 12 in the drawer.
about.section.saves.heading: Your saves
about.section.writing.body: All game text — card names and rules text, interface copy, flavour — was AI-authored under that same direction.
about.section.writing.heading: Writing

combat.protectionHelp.absorb: While active, absorbs {percent}% of {kind} damage. The damage it absorbs is taken off the pool, and when the pool is empty the owner is Staggered. Block cards restore {restores} by their Block amount, up to each maximum.
combat.protectionHelp.barrier: Barrier is blue, the layer above Ward. Magic sources and cards that add Ward refill Ward first and the rest becomes Barrier; other sources add Barrier directly. Barrier soaks magic hits completely before Ward and lasts until the start of its owner's next turn.
combat.protectionHelp.block: Absorbs attack damage. Expires at the start of the owner's turn unless an effect preserves it.
combat.protectionHelp.counter: Return half incoming damage and Poise
combat.protectionHelp.poise: Poise guards against physical hits. Full at the start of every fight, it absorbs each physical hit after Block (each hit still lets at least 1 damage through) and is spent by what it absorbs. When it breaks, a player pays 1 Stamina next turn; an enemy is interrupted. It does not regenerate unless a card, feat, class feature or relic restores it.
combat.protectionHelp.poiseOnly: While active, Poise takes {percent}% off each hit (you take the rest, rounded down) and loses what it absorbed. The damage it absorbs is taken off the pool, and when the pool is empty the owner is Staggered. Block cards restore Poise by their Block amount, up to its maximum.
combat.protectionHelp.ward: Ward guards against magic. Full at the start of every fight, it absorbs each magic hit after Barrier (each hit still lets at least 1 damage through) and is spent by what it absorbs; a Ward break costs Stamina next turn. Block does not stop magic. It does not regenerate unless a card, feat, class feature or relic restores it.

rewards.refusal.blocked: There is no room for this. Skip it or leave it.
rewards.refusal.noRoom: Your bag already holds this, or is full.
rewards.refusal.saveFailed: Could not save the claim; nothing was taken.
rewards.refusal.spent: This draft is no longer open.
runEnd.historyLater: The run history arrives in a later build.
runPotions.combatOnly: Only in combat. You can drop it here.
runPotions.keep: Charge flasks stay with the run
runPotions.setting: Turn on Use flasks outside combat in Settings to drink here
runPotions.title: Potions
settings.animSpeed.help: Auto uses Fast with Lite rendering and Normal with Full. Choose a pace to override it.
settings.animationStepDuration.help: Sprite animation duration at normal speed. Independent of the pause between combat steps.
settings.autoCombat.help: Answers your reaction prompts for you, countering the attack you can read. It never plays cards or ends your turn.
settings.autoCombatSpeed.help: Speed while auto combat is on, in place of Combat speed. Default ×1.5. Does not change combat results.
settings.changelog.blurb: Newest changes are first. Open an entry for the player-facing detail.
settings.changelog.title: What changed
settings.colorblindSafe.help: Shift danger/heal/blight/frost colors to a more distinguishable palette.
settings.combatPacingPreset.help: Mobile fast sets the pause to 250 ms and animation duration to 195 ms. Edit either value to customize.
settings.combatSpeed.help: Scales action waits and sprite playback together. Does not change combat results.
settings.combatStepPause.help: The pause between each step of an action: the action, its animation, hit or miss, the target reaction, the final result, then the reset. 0 to 2000 ms (0 turns pauses off), default 500 ms, before the speed multiplier. Does not change combat results.
settings.controlHints.help: Show the bar of keyboard shortcuts along the bottom of the map and combat.
settings.developerTools.help: Shows tuning, rules, layout, import/export and diagnostics sections. On by default in dev builds. Remembered on this device.
settings.fullscreen.help: Fill the screen when this browser supports app-controlled fullscreen.
settings.highContrast.help: Brighter text and stronger borders throughout for readability. On by default — turn it off for the dimmer, more atmospheric palette.
settings.holdConfirm.help: Choices a run can’t take back fill as you hold them, so a mis-tap can be let go before it lands. Off returns to one tap.
settings.hoverTooltips.help: Show explanations when the pointer rests on a detail. Keyboard and explicit inspection remain available.
settings.hudShowCurrency.help: Show your Cinder balance in the HUD.
settings.hudShowPosition.help: Show the current act, seat and floor.
settings.hudShowPotions.help: Show potion and flask shortcuts where the current layout provides them.
settings.hudShowVitality.help: Show health, Mana and Stamina in the top HUD.
settings.loreFace.help: The face card lore is set in: the one line in card inspection and the lore window it opens. Every face ships with the game; Cinzel has no italic and is always set upright.
settings.loreSize.help: How large card lore is set. Stacks with Text size and UI size.
settings.mapZoom.help: Fit opens the map close enough that your current node and every node it connects to are on screen. A percentage fixes the zoom instead; + / − and ⊙ still work in the map.
settings.muteAudio.help: Turn music and sound effects on. Music also has a quick toggle beside the HUD.
settings.oneTapPlay: Tap a card to play it
settings.oneTapPlay.help: Off (the default): a tap selects the card, and the next tap on it, or picking a target, plays it. This holds in solo and in co-op. On: one tap plays a card when there is only one possible target: a self card, an all-enemy card, or one living enemy. With several enemies a tap still selects. Holding a card selects it without playing, which shows its details and Upcast.
settings.openingAutoAdvance.help: Saved with your configuration. Applies to previews and new openings.
settings.openingPlayback.help: Saved with your configuration. Applies to previews and new openings.
settings.openingSpeed.help: Saved with your configuration. Applies to previews and new openings.
settings.openingStill.help: Disables fades and camera movement. The accessibility Reduced motion setting is also respected.
settings.page.tip: Tip: the magnifier finds any setting in every section. A dot marks a setting you changed, and its Reset puts it back. Changed lists all of them.
settings.page.title: Settings
settings.performanceMode.help: Auto uses lighter effects on touch devices. Lite keeps targeting and hit feedback, reduces decorative effects, and uses fast combat pacing when pacing is Auto.
settings.playInDeckOrder.help: Your draw pile is not shuffled: you draw your cards in the order you arranged them, and a spent pile returns in that order. Card effects that shuffle still shuffle. Applies from the next fight.
settings.readableHeadings.help: Use the plain UI font for titles instead of the decorative serif.
settings.reduceFlashes.help: Suppress bright impact and proc flashes (photosensitivity). Damage numbers stay.
settings.reducedMotion.help: Calm ambient effects, drop the map pulse, and shorten animations.
settings.resetAll.body: Every setting, in every section, goes back to its default. Saves and progress are not touched.
settings.resetAll.title: Reset all settings?
settings.resetAllSettings.help: Put every setting back to its default. Asks first, and the change can be undone for a few seconds.
settings.rules.future: {profile} · applies to future new games. Existing runs keep their rules.
settings.rules.xpBounds: XP multiplier must be between 0 and 10.
settings.rules.xpPolicy: Class and used weapon XP only. Rates apply to new runs; saved runs keep their rates and earned progress.
settings.showPlayedCard.help: Show the played card flying toward its target. Off by default. Character animations, combat effects and auras still play.
settings.shrinePathGlow.help: Light the way to the nearest shrine on the act map. The lane re-aims itself as new paths open, and under fog it is drawn only as far as you can already see — it never shows you a node the fog is covering.
settings.tab.advancedTip: Optional gameplay rules, tuning, diagnostics, sync, and the changelog.
settings.tab.advancedTipRelease: Map, HUD and card appearance, lore text, the changelog and About.
settings.tip.deck: The deck editor: where you can edit, the deck’s size limits, and playing your cards in the order you arranged them.
settings.tip.interface: Map and HUD, card appearance, and confirmation controls.
settings.tip.opening: Opening artwork, dialogue, timing, motif and preview. Included in configuration exports.
settings.tip.text: Typeface, size and spacing for card lore. Interface text size and readable headings are in General → Accessibility.
settings.titleCityHold.help: Pause with the city fully lit before fading to the menu. Reduced motion skips this pause.
settings.tooltipCloseDelay.help: Wait after leaving a detail and its explanation before closing it.
settings.tooltipDelay.help: Wait before opening or switching hover and nested explanations. A tap or click selects a detail; a second one explains it.
settings.uiScale.help: Auto flexes the whole interface with your screen; S–XL asks for a fixed size and gets as much of it as fits.
settings.viewPreset.help: Choose a layout for this device. Auto follows the window size.
settings.walkedFade.help: How much the nodes you have already visited fade on the act map, so the way forward stands out from the trail behind you. Half mutes them to half saturation; Off keeps the trail as bright as the choice.
slots.corrupt: This slot could not be read.
slots.label: Slot {slot}
slots.newerBuildKept: This slot holds a climb saved by a newer build of Ashen Spire. It is kept exactly as it is; update the game to continue it.
slots.newerRow: Saved by a newer build. Update to continue.
slots.refusal.later: The climb screens arrive in a later build.

spoils.level.title: Level up
spoils.note: Choose {count}. Add the card to your deck or keep it in your collection.
spoils.noteArmoury: Choose {count}. Add the card to your deck or edit your deck now; the rest stays in your collection.
spoils.refusal.full: Your deck is full ({max} cards). Edit your deck to make room.
spoils.refusal.limit: This card cannot join your deck right now.
title.pressAny.controller: Press A / Cross or Start / Menu
title.subtitle: A roguelike deckbuilder
title.tagline: The ember flows upward. Follow it.
transfer.confirm.consequence: All {count} slots and the profile will be replaced. A previous-save backup is kept first. The game returns to the title with the imported saves.
transfer.confirm.title: Replace this browser’s saves?
transfer.err.noFile: No backup file to import. Put AshenSpire-saves.json in {path} and try again.
transfer.err.stopped: Import stopped. Download the previous-save backup to recover your original progress.
transfer.err.title: Return to the title screen before importing saves.
transfer.err.unreadable: This is not a readable save file.
transfer.err.unsupported: Unsupported save file. Export a backup from Download & saves.
transfer.err.write: The browser could not save the imported data.
transfer.heading: Move your saves
transfer.note: A backup includes your profile and all {count} save slots. Import replaces them in this browser. Existing archives stay here. Import from the title screen.
transfer.title: Download & saves
